body:
Real, confirmed-live gap from the audit closed: turbogrep '[0-9]' file was silently matching zero lines where real grep finds matches. Implemented char-class-matches?/char-in-any-range? + a vec-charrange-at #target helper (same elem-type-hint-gap workaround pattern used throughout this session). Verified against real grep: [0-9], [a-m] (range), and negated [^0-9] all byte-identical. Full 7-pattern regression suite still passes, all 336 compiler tests pass.

⚓ ☃
title: CharClass ([abc]/[a-z]/[^abc]) implemented -- closes the most dangerous audit finding
